name: SaleChaty – AI Chatbot
author: SaleChaty100

sections.description:
An all-channel intelligent customer marketing contact platform based on LLM (Large Language Model), integrating online chat (Livechat), WhatsApp,Facebook,Messenger,Instagram,Telegram,Line,Email,Wechat.

Omni-channel communication, marketing promotion: mass distribution, distribution plan

  • Deliver effective communication and marketing solutions through web chat, WhatsApp APP, WhatsApp API, Facebook Messenger & Posts, Telegram, Telegram APP, Line, Slack, WeChat and other channels to assist customers in cost reduction and efficiency enhancement.

Automated, AI bot: fully automated hosted chat

  • With our customized automation functions powered by a professional process engine, combined with the intelligence of an AI robot, tasks are executed fully automatically to unleash productivity completely and help customers reduce over 90% of repetitive workload.

Team collaboration, customer management: shared chat, session allocation, efficient customer service

  • Support multiple allocation strategies, allocate customers to customer service according to policies, reduce the uneven distribution of customer service. The chat interface displays customer information, customer labels and other information in detail, and supports chat information one-click automatic translation and robot hosting.

Tags

  • An all-channel intelligent customer
  • Based on LLM (Large Language Model)

External Services

This plugin obtains the configuration of the seat segment by connecting to SaleChaty’s API. This service is necessary for displaying chat plugins.

Data Handling:

  • When the plugin was first bound just now, it was associated with the agent through the SaleChaty API, which the user clicked to bind.

Privacy and User Consent:

  • The plugin will only initiate a request with the user’s consent.

External Service Provider:

  • API Service: SaleChaty
  • Website: https://salechaty.com
  • Domain: https://app.salechaty.com/#/app-integration/independent-station
  • API: https://app.salechaty.com
  • Service Agreement: https://ospin.salechaty.com/html/service_agreement.html
  • Privacy Policy: https://ospin.salechaty.com/html/privacy_clause.html
